# ALM/Law.com reports on Burford's interest in investing in Management Services Organizations (MSOs)


- Law firm equity


August 18, 2025


-
-
-
-


In an article entitled "For Burford Capital, MSOs Represent a New Form of Law Firm Investment" ALM/Law.com reports on Burford's interest in investing in "separate legal entities known as management services organizations, or MSOs, which often offer back-office support to law firms."


[Read the full article here.](https://www.law.com/americanlawyer/2025/08/19/for-burford-capital-msos-represent-a-new-form-of-law-firm-investment/)
